item.description: Porous-material adsorption studies require coordinated structure preparation, force-field selection, simulation, validation, and interpretation, making end-to-end automation difficult. item.description: Human capital management platforms are starting to embed software agents built on large language models. item.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
item.description: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them.
